title: Map search phrase to different indexes
body:
Hi,

i am looking to create a search where the user searches "fast car" and the response is ordered by speed in descending order with all cars where max\_speed (int) >=180? Another example is a user searches for "cheap women shoes" and get all women shoes with a price lower than 50 ordered by price ascending.

What's the best way to implement this behaviour? My first idea was to create a master search index in front with a few documents for fast/slow, cheap/expensive, dark/light, etc. These results map to the real indexes with their own order. But there are some disadvantages like many indexes and more operations which result in higher cost.

I am very excited to receive your ideas.
